I stopped using the service and deleted the app, but I was still charged again even though I was no longer using Nebula.

I did not intend to authorize these recurring charges, and I am requesting a full refund for all unexpected charges.

I have already contacted Nebula Support by email regarding this issue and provided my account information. Please check my email and process my refund request as soon as possible.

I am currently giving the app 1 star because of the unclear billing experience. I will update this review depending on how Nebula handles and resolves my refund request.

provenance.title: Unexpected Charges – Refund Requested
provenance.official_reply:
Hi,

Thank you for bringing your experience to our attention. We are truly sorry for the surprise and frustration caused by the unexpected charges. We realize how confusing it is to see ongoing billing continue after removing the application, as deleting the app unfortunately does not automatically stop an active recurring plan. We never wish to process charges without clear understanding, and all renewal terms and billing schedules are meant to be outlined prior to purchase.

We want to help sort this out and address your refund request without delay. Please email our team directly at support-appstore@asknebula.com with your account details so we can review your billing history and assist you immediately.

Guiding you toward clarity,
Nebula
